title: Content checks
description: Recent messages stopped by content checks.

settings.title: Check settings
settings.description: Configure the content check service, review limits, and automatic disposition.

enabled.label: Enable checks
enabled.description: When enabled, input, output, public shares, and public assistant publishing are checked first.

mode.label: Check mode
mode.description: Use the standard check endpoint or a chat classifier that returns structured decisions.

failStrategy.label: Failure strategy
failStrategy.description: Choose whether requests are allowed or blocked when the check service is unavailable.

baseURL.label: Service URL
baseURL.description: Root URL for the compatible service, without the trailing endpoint path.

apiKey.label: Access key
apiKey.description: Saved keys are not shown again; saving an empty value keeps the existing key.

model.label: Check model
model.description: Model name used for content checks or chat classification.

threshold.label: Hit threshold
threshold.description: Scores at or above this value count as a hit. Use a value from 0 to 1.

action.label: Hit action
action.description: The current action is to block matched content.

timeoutSeconds.label: Timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for each check request.

classifierTemplate.label: Classifier prompt
classifierTemplate.description: System prompt used by chat classifier mode. Supports {{DIRECTION}} and {{CONTENT}} placeholders.
classifierTemplate.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default prompt.

autoWindowHours.label: Review window
autoWindowHours.description: How many recent hours are counted for automatic disposition.

autoLimitThreshold.label: Rate-limit threshold
autoLimitThreshold.description: When hits in the window reach this value, the account gets a temporary lower request rate. Use 0 to disable.

autoSuspendThreshold.label: Suspend threshold
autoSuspendThreshold.description: When hits in the window reach this value, the account is suspended and active sessions are ended. Use 0 to disable.

autoLimitRPM.label: Rate-limit RPM
autoLimitRPM.description: Requests per minute allowed after automatic rate limiting.

autoLimitDurationMinutes.label: Rate-limit duration
autoLimitDurationMinutes.description: Minutes that automatic rate limiting lasts. Review release clears it earlier.

outputWindowChars.label: Output check window
outputWindowChars.description: How many streamed reply characters trigger each output check.

toast.loadFailed: Check settings could not be loaded.
toast.saveFailed: Check settings could not be saved.

detail.title: Record #{id}
detail.description: Review the content snapshot, category result, and disposition history.

dialog.reviewDescription: Save the review result for record #{id}.
dialog.releaseDescription: Restore the account affected by record #{id} and mark the record as resolved.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Record the reason for later review.

toast.releaseFailed: Automatic disposition could not be released.
